mavzu: Unit 7: International relationship. Lesson 2.B. Youth organization in Uzbekistan

savollar.savol: Berilgan namunada (I'll help you type up the report) qaysi reported speech fe'li ishlatilgan?
"Remind" fe'li reported speech'da qanday ma'noni ifodalaydi?
Darslikda berilgan reported speech fe'llari qatorini toping.
variantlar: ask, tell, say, speak, talk, discuss
run, jump, swim, read, write, play
go, come, stay, leave, arrive, depart
decide, offer, complain, accuse, advise, remind

savollar.savol: "Accuse" fe'li reported speech'da qanday vaziyatni bildiradi?
Report tuzilishida "subheading" nimani anglatadi?
variantlar: Har bir paragrafning chap tomonidagi kichik sarlavha

savollar.savol: Report oxirida odatda nima qilish so'raladi?
"Perhaps we could consider..." iborasi matnda qanday maqsadda qo'llaniladi?
Anna oilasi birgalikda asosan qaysi faoliyat bilan shug'ullanadi?
Anna'ning singlisi qaysi faoliyatni davom ettirishni tanlagan?
"Don't mistake activity for achievement" shiori kimga tegishli?
"After giving the matter some serious thought, we have now reached a final decision" gapini reported speech'ga o'tkazishda qaysi fe'l ishlatiladi?
"I really think I should have been hired for that work. I'm very unhappy about the fact that I wasn't" gapi reported speech'da qaysi fe'l bilan ifodalanadi?
"Someone's been reading my diary... It was you, wasn't it?" gapi reported speech'da qaysi fe'l bilan beriladi?
"You're quite shy... I really think you should be more sociable" gapi qaysi fe'l bilan reported speech'ga o'giriladi?
"Useful" so'zining mos antonimini aniqlang.
"Friendly" so'zining mos antonimini aniqlang.
"Winner" so'zining mos antonimini aniqlang.
"...needs ___" bo'shlig'iga mos so'zni tanlang: "You might be asked to write a report when a person in authority needs ___."
"We should make a book" gapini formal tavsiyaga aylantirishda matndagi namunaga ko'ra qaysi ibora ishlatiladi?
"We should prepare questions for the interview" gapini formal qilishda qaysi ibora mos keladi?
Berilgan 5 ta direct speech namunasidan nechtasida norozilik yoki ayblash ma'nosi mavjud (complain yoki accuse)?
Anna va uning singlisi o'rtasidagi asosiy qiziqish farqi nimada?
variantlar: Anna musiqani yomon ko'radi, singlisi yaxshi ko'radi
Anna jamoaviy sportni, singlisi esa individual gimnastikani afzal ko'radi
Ikkalasi ham faqat sport bilan shug'ullanadi

savollar.savol: Report yozish tuzilishida to'g'ri ketma-ketlikni aniqlang.
Matnga ko'ra, extracurricular faoliyatlar o'quvchilarga qanday foyda keltiradi?
variantlar: Yuqori akademik ko'rsatkich, vaqtni boshqarish va stressni kamaytirish

savollar.savol: "Showing" so'ziga mantiqan mos antonimni tanlang.
Report yozishda ishlatiladigan asosiy tushunchalar (information, aim, subheading, recommend) jami nechta elementni tashkil qiladi?
6 ta reported speech fe'lidan (decide, offer, complain, accuse, advise, remind) nechtasi salbiy/norozilik ma'nosiga ega?
Anna'ning "Never stop learning because life never stops teaching" mottosi uning qanday qarashini aks ettiradi?
"Confidence" so'ziga mantiqan mos antonimni tanlang.
Matndagi ma'lumotlarga ko'ra, Anna gimnastika mashg'ulotlariga nima sababdan qatnashgan, lekin uni davom ettirmagan?
variantlar: U musiqa bilan band bo'lgani uchun
U jamoaviy sportni ko'proq yoqtirgani uchun
